description: Create a new webhook endpoint subscribed to one or more events. It starts enabled and receives every later matching event. Not idempotent: calling it again with the same URL creates a second endpoint with its own secret - to change an existing endpoint use update_webhook, and see list_webhooks first. Refused when the URL is not a public https endpoint, an event is unknown or needs a permission the caller lacks, or the workspace already has 20 endpoints. Returns { secret, endpoint }: secret is the signing secret, returned only here and never again (rotate_webhook_secret issues a new one); endpoint is the stored endpoint - its URL, events, enabled state and description - without any secret.

description.description: Free-text note shown with the endpoint, at most 500 characters. Blank is stored as null.

events.description: Event names to subscribe to, from list_webhook_event_types. An unknown name is refused; duplicates collapse to one.

url.description: Public https URL that receives the signed POST deliveries. localhost, .local, .internal and private IP addresses are refused.

name: create_webhook
title: Create webhook
